reviews.title: Great monitor, switching from LG.
reviews.comment: Love this monitor, true 3840 x 2160p @60hz. The screen is very bright and doesn't have much glare, probably none at all. Good price too, I ended up buying a second one. I am switching from LG monitors because LG sucks and they make bad products that have poor UI. The power cord is plenty long, I wish it came with a longer HDMI cable like 8 feet vs the 6 foot one that comes with but that might not matter to other customers. I don't use the stand that comes with it and use pole-mount stands, but I tried on the OEM stand and it was plenty sturdy.
reviews.author: Harley Holliday

reviews.title: High quality and well made monitor with outstanding price for performance
reviews.comment: I've always like Dell monitors and this one is outstanding. Nice matt colors and very sharp. The 32 inch size is great and any larger would cause me to have to move my head too much. The depth of view is great and viewing angle is excellent. The performance is great and I haven't run too many games through it yet, but the ones I have are perfect. Great price on a fantastic monitor.
reviews.author: DL NB

reviews.title: Good Monitor!
reviews.comment: I saw my mom bought one of these for her setup and thought I should get one too it looked so nice. This thing is a great upgrade from my previous monitor that capped out at a significantly lower resolution. I've had it for months now and video of 1080p and up looks way better and games look nice on it. I like how you can adjust the height (though it is a little finicky).
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.title: Fantastic monitor. Especially for the price I got it at.
reviews.comment:
I was a little worried because I had heard buying certain things on black Friday was a mistake.
But I’ve had smaller Dell accessories in the past. And they’re reputable as far as I was aware even though I’m not usually one of their customers.
Though I wasn’t aware these were the alienware folk. And frankly it shows. Regardless of how you feel about alienware this is a great monitor without the RBG bells and whistles.
It’s huge (I was aware I bought a big monitor but you don’t really understand the size until it’s in front of you. So I was so happy it was even bigger than I had expected). It’s beautiful. It works perfectly. It’s better than my 12 year old TV. 😂
I bought it for my computer but I’ve been playing my Switch on it. I love the stand and how maneuverable it is. I’m pleased as punch. Great job Dell. 👍
My only caveat is I wish the volume was a bit more conservative. Even at 1% the monitor can actually be quite loud.
And a remote. But that’s asking for something that was neither advertised or supposed to be bundled so that’s a wishlist ask.
reviews.author: VisionOasis

reviews.title: Yes
reviews.comment:
As another reviewer noted, the cardboard used in the box has a terrible smell. They should obviously address that. The monitor itself I also agree with reviews regarding color shift. To me it's not terribly significant side to side, however you can see the screen get noticeably washed out when moving up/away from the screen. Viewing angles aren't the best but honestly this is a common occurrence. I don't know about the quality of this particular VA monitor, just that IPS monitors in general tend to and SHOULD have better viewing angles. I'm pleased with it overall but it's still something to consider. I think it gets bright enough, I was more concerned before I changed the color settings because next to an IPS monitor the white was more yellow. They're different panels though and the IPS monitor is smaller and lower resolution. I think the colors look good - great and the monitor itself gets bright enough unless you have a very bright environment where I could see 'potential' for issues. What really surprised me was the bump in clarity. I understand some monitors are sharper but having nothing similar to compare it to, I'm satisfied with the resolution and it absolutely blows away a 1080 monitor. The speakers are excellent. They're not a replacement for dedicated speakers but they can certainly be used as such. It's not necessarily the quality but the loudness. They get LOUD. The quality is also very good. They're approaching the sound quality of a good, large TV. The interface is operated via button on the back and slightly annoying but easy to use and functional. A prompt came up on the screen to download additional software to customize the display. I honestly didn't know a monitor does this, I'm assuming through Windows update. I haven't done that yet and I'm satisfied with the quality enough that I might not get around to it. Setup was easy enough although I found it odd that there was no instruction manual whatsoever in the box. Not mine at least. Light bleed around the edges is practically non existent (on this panel) and the colors and resolution are good. I haven't noticed any flickering or dead pixels. BTW the monitor is flipped in the manufacturer box and Amazon placed it front of the box side up, which is logical and they probably don't know it's upside down in the box, but so that means it constantly got dropped directly on the screen whenever it was set down. They also shipped it inside another box for whatever reason so the package was massive. I'll update this review if anything odd starts happening but as of now I'm satisfied with it and would recommend it.
Pros:
Resolution
Speakers
Display colors
Design
Size
Cons/not the best:
Huge Amazon box 🤔
Brightness
Color shift
Noxious packaging
No instructions
Price
